displayPattern: LED behind the blower-door view port on a York TG9S. Each flash is 1/3 second on and 1/3 second off, then a 2-second pause: 4 red flashes
meaning: The main limit switch has opened its normally closed contacts. The control runs the supply air blower and the inducer while the limit stays open.
diySteps: With power off at the furnace switch, check the filter and replace it if it is packed with dust. Use the size printed on the old filter

If the limit has not closed within five minutes, the manual says the control assumes the blower is not functioning, starts a hard lockout, and flashes 11 red flashes. Power has to be cycled after that problem is corrected
If the main limit opens five times in one call for heat, the control still shows 4 red flashes and enters a one-hour soft lockout
Technician: check duct size, blower speed, firing rate, limit switch wiring and the blower motor
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician if 4 red flashes return after a filter change, or if the light changes to 11 red flashes.
